GateQuestion.description: Schema for an individual extracted GATE question.

id.description: Unique identifier for the question (e.g., '2024_CS1_Q01' or '2018_CS_GA_Q01')
id.title: Id

question_number.description: Question number as printed in the exam paper
question_number.title: Question Number

section.description: Section name (e.g. 'General Aptitude' or 'Computer Science and Information Technology')
section.title: Section

section_code.description: Standard 2-letter section code: GA (General Aptitude) or CS (Computer Science)
section_code.title: Section Code

question_type.description: Question type: Multiple Choice (MCQ), Multiple Select (MSQ), or Numerical Answer Type (NAT)
question_type.title: Question Type

marks.description: Marks allocated for correct answer (typically 1.0 or 2.0)
marks.title: Marks

question_text.description: Clean text, markdown, or LaTeX representation of the question stem
question_text.title: Question Text

options.description: Options dictionary mapping 'A', 'B', 'C', 'D' to their text. Null/None for NAT questions.
options.title: Options

has_images.description: Whether question contains images. Must be false for all extracted questions as questions containing images are omitted.
has_images.title: Has Images

page_start.description: Starting page number of the question in the PDF (1-indexed)
page_start.title: Page Start

page_end.description: Ending page number of the question in the PDF (1-indexed)
page_end.title: Page End

GateQuestion.title: GateQuestion

description: Schema for a parsed GATE exam paper.

paper_id.description: Identifier of the paper matching filename (e.g., '2026_CS1', '2018_CS')
paper_id.title: Paper Id

session.description: Session or set designator (e.g., 'Set 1', 'CS1', 'CS2', or None)
session.title: Session

total_questions_in_paper.description: Total questions identified in the source paper (typically 65)
total_questions_in_paper.title: Total Questions In Paper

extracted_questions_count.description: Count of questions extracted (text-only, images omitted)
extracted_questions_count.title: Extracted Questions Count

omitted_questions_count.description: Count of questions omitted due to containing images, diagrams, or scanned format
omitted_questions_count.title: Omitted Questions Count

questions.description: List of text-only questions parsed from this paper
questions.title: Questions

title: GatePaper
